attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"They have been raiding homesteads near the Merrow road, as I reported last time.","severity":"minor","reason":"implies ongoing raiding (\"have been raiding\"); the briefing gives a past raid of two homesteads"},{"span":"a measure to double the guards","severity":"minor","reason":"the pairing is said to double the guards; the briefing gives no such reason or effect, and it repeats the earlier bulletin's claim"},{"span":"They are reportedly moving due to grass fires in the south.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news from the latest bulletin as if current; the briefing's old-news list does not include it"},{"span":"They claim they are not seeking conflict.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news from the latest bulletin"}],"voice":2,"clarity":4,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The bulletin pads a quiet week with three plain faction-size items and recycles old news and an earlier joke without clear marking as old, so the dry voice is thin. Wit is mostly absent, and the guard-doubling line and Kinn repetition add unsupported detail."}
